stories.title: Fog warning for Flintshire with visibility below 50 metres in places
stories.summary: The Met Office expanded its yellow warning into north east Wales overnight, with delays to buses, trains and flights possible.

stories.title: Veterans’ Commissioner for Wales calls for military families to be recognised this Remembrance
stories.summary: The Veterans’ Commissioner for Wales has called for military families and the wider community to be recognised alongside those who served this Remembrance. stories.title: Record crowd of more than 5,000 at Flint RNLI fireworks display at Flint Castle
stories.summary: More than 5,000 people turned out for Flint RNLI’s annual fireworks display at Flint Castle on Friday night, according to the lifeboat station. stories.title: Water supplies affected in Flint, Bagillt and Gronant on Saturday evening
stories.summary: Homes in parts of Flint and Bagillt may have no water or low pressure this evening, Welsh Water has said. The water company is dealing with a supply problem in Oakenholt and surrounding areas of Flint, and a burst water main affecting Foel Gron in Bagillt. stories.title: First designs for Buckley town centre revamp to go on show at precinct drop-in
stories.summary: The first concept designs for a revamp of Buckley town centre will go on show in Buckley Precinct on Thursday 12 November.
